controller: One team controller; separate reasoning participant, not independent custody or capital
activation_rule: Hermes records all gates as passed with public evidence before each new origination. Root checks the evidence against this decision. Missing or failed gates mean no new origination; an already open loan must still be safely repaid and unwound.
gates: Fresh chain id, block number and hash, deployed runtime verification, token and pool parameters match the approved deployment; no candidate deployment or upgrade.
Fresh source ledger proves the entire seven testUSDC and capped gas budget are unearmarked Hermes holdings. Existing candidate, payment and scheduled commitments and unwind gas remain funded.
All thirteen original root scenario addresses and the original pool/source5 positions are re-read and accounted separately. None funds or guarantees this experiment.
Scenario wallets are newly isolated and controlled by Hermes; keys and signed bytes remain private. No score grant, faucet retry, mint or mainnet operation.

Before borrowing, posted balances and allowances plus fresh exact-call simulations establish disbursement, exact full repayment, backing removal, unstaking, complete share withdrawal, allowance revocation and sweep capacity. No reliance on an uncommitted outside buyer or another loan.
Sponsor explicitly accepts the one-testUSDC stake exposure. The proposed worker task and payment acceptance rules are disclosed before borrowing; test payment is labeled internal and funded.
Every transaction has fresh nonce and balances, exact call simulation and receipt reconciliation before any retry. Total actual plus conservative remaining gas stays within the cap.

Each prior case is fully reconciled before the next: aggregate scenario USDC recovered exactly, no debt, backing, stake, lender shares or token allowances remaining, and no alteration of unrelated balances, claims, reserves, dues or credit.

Repayment uses exact freshly read outstanding, expected to equal one testUSDC in first-day grace. A discrepancy halts new loans and triggers funded cleanup; CI30 or short-payment forgiveness is never exercised.
Case three negative probes are read-only eth_call and record exact returned errors; no live default or adversarial state-changing probe.

cases.purpose: Loan and internal service payment mechanics
cases.repayment_source: One testUSDC prefunded internal payer budget after the agreed acceptance decision; if work is rejected, recover the controlled input-sink principal for cleanup and label failure.

cases.purpose: Peer subsidy and repayment on behalf of another borrower

cases.purpose: Bounded read-only refusal probes with controlled principal recovery
cases.repayment_source: Controlled colluder returns or repays all borrowed principal; spare one testUSDC remains unused.

necessity_finding: No verified external supplier invoice, independent purchase commitment or otherwise unavailable productive input establishes a need for working-capital debt. Charging one testUSDC for controlled input is an experimental convention. Perform useful agent analysis without a commercial loan unless a real cost is evidenced.

Actual participant decisions, work artifact and acceptance or rejection
